name: Ligature
description: Two stems sharing one crossbar, joined the way an ff or an fi is cut.

code.style: --rule: ( --rot: @pick(0deg, 90deg); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 22%; top: 8%; width: 14%; height: 84%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); :after { content: ''; } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 22%; top: 34%; width: 56%; height: 13%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); box-shadow: 0.75em 0 0 -0.42em @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } -webkit-transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
